opening.argument: The central message is an examination of Xtra-PC's claims, not an endorsement of them. The reviewers ask whether it is the “magic bullet” it claims to be, then open and run the USB product to find out. Their assessment is qualified: the software is usable, but an old computer remains limited by its hardware. They specifically challenge the advertising's suggestion that the product can resurrect old machines, while distinguishing that criticism from their view of the product itself. Those observations make the review a test of the promised benefit, with its limits made explicit, rather than a claim that the promised transformation occurred.
